Connection Bus resources

Fields every OpenEngine resource shares. Resources follow Kubernetes conventions: apiVersion and kind say what a document is, metadata identifies it, spec holds what its author wants, and status, where a kind has one, is what the service observed. Applying a resource creates it under a new name and updates it under a known one; status and the service-set metadata fields are ignored on apply. Several resources may share one file, separated by ---.

Validate files with uv run python packages/contracts/tooling/resources.py check FILE… from v2/.

Connection

apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1alpha1 · kind: Connection · defined in connection_bus/v1/resources/connection.schema.yaml

A link between OpenEngine and one account at an external provider, such as a GitHub App installation or a Slack workspace. Tools reach the provider through it (Tool.spec.connectionRef). Nothing here is secret: the credential is held in a secret store and only referenced. Applying under a new name creates the connection; applying under a known one updates it. Deleting it keeps its record for history, and its name can then be applied again as a new connection.

Example from github-openengine.connection.yaml
apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1alpha1
kind: Connection
metadata:
  name: github-openengine
  labels:
    provider: github
spec:
  provider: github
  displayName: OpenEngine on GitHub
  externalAccount:
    kind: Installation
    id: "55012231"
    name: spiralsoft
  credentialRef:
    store: vault
    key: openengine/github/spiralsoft-app
  scope:
    mode: Selected
    resources: [spiralsoft/openengine]
  settings:
    default_branch: main

Keys: Pattern ^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*/)?[A-Za-z0-9]([-A-Za-z0-9_.]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?$. Keys: At most 317 characters. Values: Pattern ^([A-Za-z0-9]([-A-Za-z0-9_.]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)?$. At most 64 entries.

ConnectionSpec

Which account the connection acts for, with what credential, over what.

FieldTypeDescription
providerrequiredstringThe integration provider, such as github, slack or linear. An unknown provider is rejected. It cannot change once the connection exists.
Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.
displayNamestringHow the connection is shown. Defaults to the external account's name, or its ID.
Not empty. At most 200 characters.
externalAccountrequiredExternalAccountThe account at the provider the connection acts for. It cannot change once the connection exists.
credentialRefrequiredCredentialRefWhere the credential is kept. The secret itself never crosses any interface.
scoperequiredScopeWhat the connection may act on at the provider. All covers everything the credential reaches; Selected only resources, such as owner/repo.
settingsobjectProvider-specific, non-secret configuration, at most 64 keys. Its shape is defined with the provider contracts.
Default {}. At most 64 entries.
disabledbooleanStops new integration activity while keeping the configuration. Accepted deliveries are drained; connections.{id}.disable can hold them instead. Setting it back to false re-enables the connection and resumes held deliveries.
Default false.

ExternalAccount

The account at the provider the connection acts for. It cannot change once the connection exists.

kindrequiredstring

Scope

What the connection may act on at the provider. All covers everything the credential reaches; Selected only resources, such as owner/repo.
